description: Distill a reusable voice from a Collection of mined content: analyzes the top-engagement items and reverse-engineers a voiceProfile (tone, diction, cadence, emoji/formatting habits, themes, dos/donts) + representative exemplars. Requires the collection to have >=3 usable samples. Runs an LLM call (a few seconds).

collectionId.description: Source Collection UUID (built by the web agent / content mining).

name.description: Persona name. Defaults to '<collection name> voice'.

sampleLimit.description: How many top-engagement items to analyze (default 40).

name: neuron_build_persona
title: Build Persona from Collection
